read.thesis: UBS Q3 2024 underlying PBT $2.4bn (up 2.5x) with CET1 14.3% after voluntary PPA phaseout; cost saves $750m to pass halfway to $13bn, but cost saves to slow for migration phase, and NCL/GWM NII headwinds persist.

triggers.label: Cost saves $750m; past halfway to $13bn
triggers.quote: achieved 750 million in additional annualized gross cost saves, putting us past the halfway mark towards our 13 billion goal
triggers.highlight: past the halfway mark towards our 13 billion goal

triggers.label: Cost saves to moderate next quarters
triggers.quote: As we continue our client account and platform migration work across our divisions and regions in the months ahead, we estimate sequential cost saves to be similarly sized.
triggers.highlight: we estimate sequential cost saves to be similarly sized

triggers.label: NNA $25bn; on track for $100bn 2024
triggers.quote: we remain on track to deliver on our 100 billion NNA ambition for 2024
triggers.highlight: on track to deliver on our 100 billion NNA ambition

triggers.label: Basel III CET1 hit cut to ~30bp
triggers.quote: is now expected to reduce our CET1 capital ratio by around 30 basis points upon implementation next year
triggers.highlight: reduce our CET1 capital ratio by around 30 basis points

triggers.label: GWM NII to drop mid-single digit in Q4
triggers.quote: we expect a sequential mid-single-digit percentage drop in NII
triggers.highlight: sequential mid-single-digit percentage drop in NII

guidance.quote: By the end of this year, we plan to have delivered around 7.5 billion in annualized gross cost saves
we expect to recognize total pull-to-par revenues of 6.4 billion over the next several years
is now expected to reduce our CET1 capital ratio by around 30 basis points upon implementation next year
we expect a sequential mid-single-digit percentage drop in NII
reach our target ratio of under 70% by the end of 2026
returns to around 15% by the end of 2026

red_flags.label: Q4 deposit roll-off elevated
red_flags.quote: we expect elevated maturing deposit volumes over the next 2 quarters

red_flags.label: NCL RWA pace hard to sustain
red_flags.quote: the pace that we're running at is a pace that would be very hard to sustain

evasions.quote: I don’t know. We are not really in control of the timing.
it would be premature to draw a conclusion around what the new regulation will be
